goal: Refactor the shared system-media and OpenCode music-player architecture so authoritative media-control stream snapshots update playback immediately; stream termination triggers immediate recovery; transport intents are queued or represented explicitly instead of silently dropped behind a global busy latch; provider sampling, command execution, artwork enrichment, and UI projection use separate concurrency lanes; playback clock state is backend-scoped rather than module-global; artwork completion updates presentation independently; bounded polling remains only as recovery and for polling-only providers. Preserve current play, pause, seek, artwork, Kitty rendering, Pi compatibility, and package interfaces where justified. Add deterministic regressions for app-originated pause, stream termination, delayed refresh with repeated controls, and lifecycle cleanup. Plan this as reviewable tracer phases on top of fix/music-player-sync without modifying PR #40.
